name: Zoho CRM
one_liner: Zoho CRM sales CRM with REST API v8, notification webhooks and official pre-built MCP servers.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 only; client registered in Zoho Developer Console (server, client-based, mobile, self client). Multi-DC: accounts and API domains differ per region.
access_notes: Developer Console registration is open; API credit table includes a Free Edition (5000 credits/24h) and trial editions share paid-edition limits. Higher tiers get more credits. Per-region data center handling required.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve OAuth client registration, documented REST API with credit-based limits, notification webhooks and official MCP. Caveats: multi-datacenter domains and edition-based credit limits.

needs_human_reason: Sandbox availability and edition gating not verified.

evidence.quote: Go to Zoho Developer Console and click on GET STARTED.
Notification APIs allow you to get instant notifications whenever an action is performed on the records of a module.
API Usage in Zoho CRM is calculated based on credits

disputes.why: Developer Console is open; API limits table includes Free Edition with 5000 credits.
v8 docs cover metadata, records, composite, bulk, notifications, COQL; count not verified.
Evidence now supports self-serve credentials and documented API.
